arStrings.szText: {c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also grants you and your allies {c_number}[SF_8*100]%{/c} Maximum Life.
{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} increases your damage by {c_number}[SF_10*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds whenever you gain {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also Heals you and your allies for {c_number}[SF_13*100]%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_13})]){/c} per second.

Healing yourself or allies grants {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} every {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} second.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also grants {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} Thorns and increases all Thorns damage by {c_number}[SF_17*100|%x|]{/c} for you and your allies.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} active instead releases a nova dealing {c_number}[SF_20*100|%x|]{/c} of your Thorns damage.
